summary_en: The video provides a comprehensive tutorial on preparing grilled eggplant with shredded dried shrimp. Two female chefs present the fresh ingredients, prep and slice the eggplants, mix seasonings, prepare chive oil, and stir-fry dried shrimp with fried garlic. They then demonstrate how to mix a sweet and sour fish sauce dip and finish by garnishing the grilled eggplants with toppings and green onions.
